title: Memory-local execution and adaptive horizon handoff
summary: Audio processing remains ordinary ooRexx while Memory Fabric predicts the next logical working-set window and the cluster moves the compact runner to an already-resident fenced block. Queue Fabric carries execution/control state, not resident PCM; placement authority remains external in Job-to-Node.
invariants: Audio objects remain cluster-unaware: they express logical processing and continuation state, not node addresses, Queue Fabric operations or Memory Fabric placement policy.
Memory Fabric owns logical memory/block identity, residency, block generation, provider identity, provider owner epoch, sparse working-set projection and adaptive horizon demand.
Job-to-Node owns hard eligibility, admission, ranking and placement leases; the memory-horizon adapter may only revalidate an existing executable placement decision.
Queue Fabric carries the runner/object/control envelope. Resident PCM, decoded frames, STFT buffers and other bulk working data are not placed in the MOVE graph merely because execution changes node.
Storage Fabric remains the durable material boundary. Memory Fabric residency and Queue Fabric movement do not redefine durable source identity.
An addressed memory reference resolves to the owning/current resident block; lack of a current resident route is not converted into an implicit block transfer.
A horizon demand is predictive. It may be raised before the current block is exhausted so the runner can move while the next resident block is ready.
Block generation and provider owner epoch are revalidated immediately before handoff. Provider reincarnation or stale block generation fails closed.
Destination MOVE acknowledgement must occur before the Memory Fabric cursor/window is advanced and before the horizon demand is marked SATISFIED.
MOVE_UNCERTAIN, failed placement verification, non-contiguous next-window mapping or missing residency leave the runner and Memory Fabric demand state unadvanced.
Explicit materialisation remains a separate operation. Memory-local execution must not be confused with gathering the distributed working set back into one process.
procedure: Read the Audio logical stream normally through the Memory Fabric-backed sparse projection.
When the adaptive event horizon is crossed, obtain the triggered demand for the next logical range.
Resolve that range only against a current fenced Memory Fabric resident block and revalidate block generation plus provider owner epoch.
Revalidate the existing Audio/Job-to-Node execution plan for the destination that owns the resident block.
Move the compact runner/object continuation through cluster.object.peer/0.2 over Queue Fabric; do not add resident PCM to the envelope.
Require positive destination acknowledgement that the runner has been reconstructed beside the fenced block.
Only after acknowledgement, advance the Memory Fabric cursor/window and mark the horizon demand satisfied.
Continue ordinary Audio processing against destination-local resident data.
